title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 1.79 (versions follow prime numbers; 179 after 173): her thought, as it is. A correction of 1.73: the green rain of Luma's panel was said to be the trials of her forms, and it was the talks of her creatures (a creature sings a piece of its gait to another, which archives it as UNFIT when it does not shorten its own description); found when the author asked what UNFIT meant, by reading the code that writes those lines. Now the rain comes from her forms' archive, her mind of recipes, as she writes it: the round, the form's place, the recipe that lost and the one it lost to, the reason (longer, not-new, crowds, no-better, replaced), both totals in bits and the jump's radius, about 29 a second. Her thoughts stay bright, the last one fixed on the left. Stated limits: each line takes three lines of the panel; the archive keeps what the judge rejected, what wins is seen in her forms above. The kernel is unchanged since 1.39. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v1.79: el panel de Luma muestra su pensamiento de formas tal como es, y corrige lo dicho en la v1.73. Prototipo de investigación.
